name: Vorgol
verdict: Russian natural-water brand whose site and sales are run by its exclusive distributor OOO «Дабл Блэк», registry-listed as owned by an individual, Evgeny Kuprin. No state in the chain and no human-rights finding found.
note: Artesian drinking-water brand from the Lipetsk region; official supplier of FC Rodina's professional teams and academy since 25 Jul 2026. The brand-to-company link is the distributor relation stated on the brand's own site (its site, offer and contacts are OOO «Дабл Блэк»'s); the source does not say OOO «Дабл Блэк» owns the brand, so the ownership field is left unset, and the registry masks Dabl Blek's share data.
